# [?] Eth2Near relay: fix overflow bug. Update DAG roots. Add&fix tests. (#548)

## Summary
Severity: Unknown
Chain: Bridge
Component: Near-One/rainbow-bridge
Published: 2021-04-05
Source: https://github.com/Near-One/rainbow-bridge/commit/77be54f1bc299f04edd991e0db4e1782d4848ba2
Type: security-commit

## Details
Eth2Near relay: fix overflow bug. Update DAG roots. Add&fix tests. (#548)

* Eth2Near: bug fix, improvements. Update DAG roots.

* Ethashproof: remove git submodule, add as a local module instead.
* Ethashproof: fix u32 overflow bug in `algorithm.go` during the
  `dataset` calculation.
* EthClient: Update DAG merkle roots.
* Update .gitignore.

* Eth2Near: add new tests. Fix old tests.

* Build fixes.

* Update eth-on-near-client init

* Update build files.

## Patch
### .gitignore
```diff
@@ -5,3 +5,7 @@ coverage
 coverage.json
 testdata
 target
+
+eth2near/ethashproof/cmd/epoch/epoch
+eth2near/ethashproof/cmd/relayer/relayer
+eth2near/ethashproof/cmd/cache/cache
```

### .gitmodules
```diff
@@ -1,4 +0,0 @@
-[submodule "eth2near/ethashproof"]
-	path = eth2near/ethashproof
-	url = https://github.com/nearprotocol/ethashproof
-	ignore = dirty
```
